about: T-523 (built 2026-11-06, the user chose A TERMINAL and the whole family): the new message box and its more-text arrow, a sign, the START menu, OPTIONS' FRAME cycled through all ten, and the box and START again on a SATURDAY at night, so the weekday's trim and the hour's tint still reach the new frames. DEBUG overrides poked and put back; the theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
